findings.documented: Returns token, no refresh flow, expires_in 86400
findings.actual: Requires X-API-Key header. Returns access_token, refresh_token, expires_in 900.
findings.how_found: Observed 401 response without X-API-Key and checked JSON response body.
findings.impact: Authentication requires refresh mechanism every 15 mins.

findings.documented: api_key passed as a query parameter
findings.actual: api_key must be passed in the X-API-Key header
findings.how_found: Query param resulted in 401, header was required.
findings.impact: API key must be placed in headers instead of URL.

findings.documented: page and limit query parameters, max limit 200
findings.actual: offset and limit query parameters, max limit 50
findings.how_found: Passing page=2 returned same results as page=1. offset=50 worked. limit=100 returned 50 records.
findings.impact: Pagination must use offset, and more requests are needed.

findings.documented: Returns active sale listings in your city. Inactive are excluded.
findings.actual: Returns both active (is_live=true) and inactive listings.
findings.how_found: Filtered fetched listings by is_live=true and got 3477 out of 4400.

findings.documented: total in pagination response is exact number of matching records
findings.actual: total is 4129, but fetching to the end yields 4400 records
findings.how_found: Paginated through all results and found 4400 records while total indicated 4129.
findings.impact: Cannot rely on total for accurate count or page calculation.

findings.actual: project_id filter is ignored and returns all listings.
findings.impact: Must manually filter by project_id on the client.

findings.documented: Supports locality, bhk, furnishing, sort_by, order
findings.actual: property_type, min_price, and max_price filters are ignored.
findings.how_found: Tested filters and they returned total 1549 (all rental records).
findings.impact: Must manually filter on the client.

findings.documented: price_min and price_max are in rupees
findings.actual: price_min and price_max are in Lakhs (e.g., 99.8 = 9,980,000 rupees)
findings.how_found: Compared project price_max with actual listing prices.
findings.impact: Must multiply by 100,000 to display in rupees.

findings.actual: Listings from MAG (magicbricks) have carpet_area in square meters
findings.how_found: Observed unusually low carpet_area (e.g. 112) for 3BHK listings and extremely high price/sqft.
findings.impact: Must convert MAG- prefix listing areas by multiplying by 10.7639.

findings.actual: Dates are timezone-naive (local IST) without a Z suffix.
findings.impact: Must parse dates as local time instead of UTC.
Cannot use this endpoint for insights screen.

findings.documented: each listing corresponds to exactly one physical property
findings.actual: Multiple listings from different websites (DWE, MAG, SQU) represent the same physical property with identical physical attributes.
findings.how_found: Found listings with identical project_id, floor, bedroom, bathroom, and facing_direction.
